card.name: Second half of CamelCase class names
card.fires_on: The second piece of a joined CamelCase programming name, such as Document, Dialog or View after a prefix like Scribble or PyC. Mostly in Python MFC (pywin) code discussion.

modes.label: Class name ending
modes.description: Final part of a class name after a prefix such as Scribble or PyC.

modes.label: Other joined names
modes.description: Second part of other run-together names, in code or elsewhere.

card.plain: It fires on the closing part of a run-together code name, like the Document in ScribbleDocument.
